symbols.name: LuxonDateTimeTransformer
symbols.sig: const LuxonDateTimeTransformer: ValueTransformer = { to(value: DateTime | null | undefined): Date | null { if (!value) return null; return value.toJSDate(); }, …
doc: I use this ValueTransformer to bridge the native database JS Dates to Luxon DateTime objects across the Next.js application layer.

members.name: sessionToken
decos: @Column({ type: "varchar", unique: true, nullable: false, name: "sessionToken", })

members.name: expires
decos: @Column({ type: "timestamp with time zone", nullable: false, transformer: LuxonDateTimeTransformer, })
